It is a tremendous honor to receive the Best of Constituent Service award from the Congressional Management Foundation. I'm incredibly proud of our amazing district office team for providing the very best constituent service in America.

In just over three years, we’ve closed nearly 6,000 individual cases returning over $20 million directly to constituents and helped communities in the district receive over $300 million in federal grants and funding support.

The Congressional Management Foundation is the premier bipartisan foundation dedicated to strengthening the first branch of government. CEO Jen Daulby said, "Rep. Kiley’s office didn’t just respond to requests; they built systems, trained teams, and stayed in the fight on cases that most people would have walked away from. When we say Congress can work, this is what we mean,"
